events.name: Unexpected Guest
events.description: A visiting lord enters the ballroom and shifts the attention of the crowd.
events.result: Each faction adjusts hand size by 1. Resolve the effect according to scenario rules.

events.name: Rival Entrance
events.description: A rival noble arrives with a dramatic flourish, drawing whispers and attention.
events.result: All players must discard one card unless they spend a charm token to avoid the distraction.
